text:
jen-partner: Hey team — heads up from Saturn's ingestion: about 3% of hourly batch lines yesterday had an empty `entitlement_id` for SKU=\"edge-pro\". Partner sent a sample above, attaching here.

mike-eng: can you paste the sample payload? quick check: are those coming from the older agent (v1.2) or v2?

jen-partner: sample below:
```json
{"device_id":"dev-91","timestamp":"2026-03-22T18:00:00Z","sku":"edge-pro","units":120,"entitlement_id":""}
```

kevin-billing: when entitlement_id is blank our ingestion path drops ledger writes -> partner gets credited automatically (we saw credits issued). That explains the mismatch in yesterday's billing run.

prashant-integrations: looks like the partner agent sometimes omits entitlement for devices that haven't been onboarded to their registry yet. Two thoughts:
- short-term: treat empty `entitlement_id` as a separate tag `unmapped_entitlement` so it still flows to the partner ledger (flagged) instead of being dropped.
- mid-term: add a validation check and a partner webhook to return a 422 with helpful text so partners fix at source.

sasha-ops: @jen-partner can you confirm how many customers this affects? Is this across regions or only EMEA? we need to decide whether to pause the joint announcement for TileWave next week.

jen-partner: affecting ~4 customers (pilot) across EMEA only. partner engineering (cc @saturn-eng) is pushing a patch they claim will fix it for future batches. timeline: patch by EOD PT.

mike-eng: quick mitigation plan from infra side:
1) accept lines with empty `entitlement_id` into a quarantine table with metadata (received_ts, raw_payload, sku).
2) emit an alert to #partnerships and create a reconciliation ticket for billing.
3) run a backfill for yesterday's hourly window to map unmapped devices after partner provides mapping.

kevin-billing: +1. If we accept into quarantine, we should mark them as non-billable until mapping confirmed. Also need a credits reconciliation run if partner requests reversal.

jen-partner: partner will provide CSV mapping device_id -> entitlement_id within 24h. They want us to avoid auto-crediting until mapping is applied.

prashant-integrations: action items:
- prashant: add quarantine ingestion path and metric (ETA 6h)
- mike-eng: add backfill job and a manual reconcile endpoint (ETA 24h)
- kevin-billing: hold on reversing credits until mapping applied, will prepare an exceptions ledger entry (ETA 24h)
- jen-partner: get CSV mapping from Saturn (ETA 24h)

marketplace-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-1457 -> Partner hourly batch unmapped-entitlement spike (severity: medium). Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-1457

sasha-ops: Given this is pilot and partner patch ETA is same day, I'm ok not delaying the TileWave joint announcement, but we need a clear customer note and a rollback plan if more pilots surface issues.

kevin-billing: I'll draft the customer-facing note about potential delayed usage show in invoices and the reconciliation SLA (we propose 48h for credits after mapping).

jen-partner: thanks — will coordinate with Saturn-eng and product marketing. keep me posted in-thread. :thumbsup:

mike-eng: I'll post a short deploy note once quarantine path is live.

prashant-integrations: logging the epic: PARTNER-ENT-QUAR-2026 and will attach example payloads + test vectors.

sasha-ops: perfect. closing loop: if we have mapping within 24h and backfill completed within 48h, proceed with TileWave as planned. otherwise pause announcement and publish an update.

jen-partner: acknowledged.

mike-eng: done: quarantine ingestion PR merged -> staging. alert rule created for >0.5% unmapped rate.

kevin-billing: prepared exception ledger template, leaving placeholder for final numbers.

marketplace-bot: Update: incident #INC-2026-1457 status -> monitoring.

jen-partner: partner shipped mapping CSV at 2026-03-23T01:12Z. attaching in email.

prashant-integrations: starting backfill now, will post progress.

mike-eng: backfill complete for the affected hourly windows. marking quarantined rows as mapped.

kevin-billing: reconciled credits and applied adjustment entries. invoice displays corrected usage.

sasha-ops: great work. moving this thread to resolved. thanks everyone. :tada:
